reason: The README describes a user-interface plugin that upgrades the DeepSeek Harness Plugins settings tab into a searchable, filterable catalog with aggregated mount points and editable persisted descriptions.

summaries.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 的插件设置页升级为支持搜索、筛选、挂载点聚合及中英文描述编辑的插件目录。
summaries.en: Upgrades the DeepSeek Harness plugin settings tab into a searchable catalog with mount-point aggregation and editable bilingual descriptions.

capabilities: Replaces the built-in plugin list tab with an enhanced catalog interface
Reads plugin profile and mount-point metadata for display and filtering
Allows bilingual plugin descriptions to be edited and persisted in $DSH_HOME/plugin-descriptions.json
Provides search, filtering, sorting, and copying of profile and entry identifiers
